name: the base is COLLECTED, not invoiced: a part payment of a mixed invoice earns its share and no more

expected.workings: eligibleBase = 100000 (the consultation line only). settleable = 156000 - 0 = 156000. collected = 60000 - 0 = 60000. targetBase = divHalfUp(100000 x 60000, 156000) = floor((2 x 6000000000 + 156000) / 312000) = floor(12000156000 / 312000) = 38462 (312000 x 38462 = 12000144000, remainder 12000). target = percentAmount(38462, 1000) = divHalfUp(38462000, 10000) = floor(76934000 / 20000) = 3846. delta = 3846 - 0 = 3846. A base that ignored `collected` would answer percentAmount(100000, 1000) = 10000.
